Protocol and lossless ID scanner source: https://github.com/Tencent/openclaw-weixin/tree/7c04adc3e95775efd661ab9fba0626d86d237713 (2.4.9-beta.0), MIT. Only HTTP wire conventions and the standalone JSON identifier scanner are used. No OpenClaw SDK, plugin, peer dependency or runtime is installed. Local adapter bot_agent identifies DesktopPet/0.1.

The local QR renderer is independently bundled with esbuild from pinned qrcode1.5.4, pngjs5.0.0 and dijkstrajs1.0.3. Their license notices are retained beside this file. No upstream OpenClaw runtime or dependencies are installed.
